Overview

The AeroLink GT8 VTX is the transmitter from the GT8 system as a standalone unit: ideal for replacements, fleet expansion or custom builds with whichever camera best suits each mission.

It runs directly from 3S to 6S batteries, records to micro SD and shows flight-controller telemetry on screen through its Canvas-mode OSD.

Key features

22 ms latencyInstant in-flight response.
11.1–25.2 V inputPowered straight from the battery.
Records in the air1080p/720p to micro SD.
Built-in fanActive heat dissipation.
Universal mounting25.5×25.5 and 20×20 mm holes.
Canvas OSDBetaflight, INAV, FETtec, KISS, ArduPilot.

Technical specifications

Video transmitter

Frequency band5.725 – 5.850 GHz
Transmit power (EIRP)Max. 33 dBm · FCC <30 dBm · CE <14 dBm · SRRC <20 dBm · MIC <25 dBm
Latency22 ms average
Channels8
Onboard recording1080p / 720p
StorageMicro SD slot, up to 256 GB
Power input11.1 – 25.2 V (reference consumption 12 V @ 1.5 A)
Connections4-pin JST 1.0 (power + UART) · 2 × IPEX antenna connectors
OSDCanvas mode (MSP DisplayPort)
Supported flight controllersBetaflight · INAV · FETtec · KISS · ArduPilot
Mounting holes25.5 × 25.5 mm and 20 × 20 mm
Dimensions33.8 × 33.8 × 23.4 mm
Weight29.7 g
Operating temperature−10 °C to 40 °C

In the box

  • Digital video transmitter with fan
  • 4-pin power / data cable

Compatibility

Camera and antennas not included. Compatible with the NightEye S2 camera and the ThermaView 960 thermal camera (GT8 version).

Applications

  • Professional FPV platforms
  • Inspection drones
  • Fleet replacement and expansion
  • Custom integrations
